ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_square_scaled_norm
ir.intuition: Normalize the weight by its mean to introduce an explicit normalization constraint, ensuring scale-invariance and stability regardless of weight magnitude distribution. This enforces the loss to be invariant to uniform scaling of weights, promoting training stability.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_sq = advantage_gap ^ 2
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weight_norm = weight / mean(weight)
loss = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_sq * weight_norm
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_sq = ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weight_mean = ops.mean(weight)
    weight_norm = ops.div(weight, weight_mean)
    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(score_diff)), adv_sq)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight_norm)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
